protocol.descriptive_flag: mean within-cohort expert-minus-current AUC > 2*paired fold SE and at least 4/5 positive
protocol.limits: Exploratory, many comparisons without multiplicity correction. Group AUC does not determine global AUC; changing a group also changes between-group ranking. Native meta-folds inherit public OOF dependencies.
